name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
🐛 Reporting access can be granted again — the «Reporting circuit A» and «circuit B» columns of the permissions table were disabled by a build flag that marks the reporting module as absent, set here by mistake. The module could be switched on for a project, but no group could be given access, so reports stayed visible to the settings manager alone. The columns are live again. Permissions you had already saved were never altered — the flag only blocked editing them. Affects 3.28.0 through 3.29.1.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade, no schema change.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
